issue.title: Deflake config detail scroll navigation under xdist
issue.description: While verifying sase-cc, the 17-worker just test run timed out in tests/ace/tui/test_config_pane_widget_navigation.py::test_config_detail_ctrl_d_u_scrolls_without_stealing_focus waiting for #config-detail-scroll.max_scroll_y > 0. The same test passed immediately when rerun serially (1.30s), indicating an xdist/load-sensitive TUI timing flake. Make the detail-layout readiness wait deterministic without weakening the Ctrl-D/Ctrl-U focus and scroll assertions.
